modelingNotes: The eight-sided OSM plan and 20 m height establish the body. No separate parts fix the arcade or parapet elevations.

The selected exterior photograph shows red terracotta, tall pointed arcades, circular upper apertures and an irregular crenellated skyline. The approved terracotta swatch is used expressly for this building.
Arcade rhythm and roof teeth are inferred at map scale. Colored ceramic patterning and carved relief are omitted.
